# Mission — Unified Movie Revelation

The Awtsmoos renews the frame, each instant born anew;
Awtsmoos.com shall shape the scene, yet every renderer stays true.

## User Outcome
Unify every movie-making app under `work/awtsmoos.com/geelooy` without erasing their distinct 2D/3D personalities. Make the authoring contract expressive enough that an AI can produce complete movies: characters, cameras, scenes, text, shapes, diagrams, tutorials, particles, transitions, motion, and layered effects. Make the UX mobile-first. Produce and verify a real ~3-minute showcase.

## Non-negotiable gates
- Inspect actual movie-capable apps before design changes.
- Preserve distinct app routes and renderer identities.
- Establish one shared declarative scene/movie contract where appropriate.
- Support 2D and 3D through adapters/renderers, not duplicate authoring languages.
- Make scene construction data-driven and AI-generatable.
- Provide deterministic timing and scene sequencing.
- Exercise many feature families in a long showcase.
- Verify syntax/build/runtime plus browser behavior.
- Re-read all touched files and compare planned vs actual.
